title: Services
subtitle: The flagship service is oral rehabilitation. The second opinion is the differentiator. Everything else with clinical criterion.

bundles.name: Initial consultation
bundles.description: Clinical review, diagnostic conversation and written plan. 45–60 minutes. This is the only step with a published price.

bundles.name: Written care plan
bundles.description: After the consultation, you receive a document with options, timelines and cost guidance. Yours, no commitment.

bundles.name: Detailed planning
bundles.description: For complex cases or full-mouth rehabilitation. Phased plan, coordination with specialists when needed.
